_comment: Перевод affixes_trigger.json на en. Числа и правила остаются в исходнике; здесь только строки. Строка, совпадающая с русской, считается непереведённой — см. tool/l10n.dart --check.

blood_tithe.name: Blood Tithe
blood_tithe.text: Killing a cursed enemy: +{fraction:%} of maximum HP

chase.name: The Chase
chase.text: On kill: +{value:%} attack speed for {duration:s}, stacking up to {maxStacks} times

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.text: On critical strike, {chance:%} chance: reset a random ability's cooldown

double_strike.name: Double Strike
double_strike.text: Every {period:s} the next ability strikes twice

frost_chain.name: Frost Chain
frost_chain.text: A chilled enemy that dies chills its neighbours for {duration:s}

pestilence.name: Pestilence
pestilence.text: Curses spread to the whole wave

reflection.name: Reflection
reflection.text: When hit, {chance:%} chance: Void damage equal to {armorFraction:%} of armor

totem_resonance.name: Totem Resonance
totem_resonance.text: Totems last {duration:%} longer and strike {rate:%} harder

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.text: First hit on a new wave: +{moreDamage:%} damage
